name: Charbel Farhat
profileSummary: Charbel Farhat is an aerospace engineer and computational scientist who is the Vivian Church Hoff Professor of Aircraft Structures in the School of Engineering at Stanford University. He is also a professor in Stanford's Institute for Computational and Mathematical Engineering. From 2008 to 2023, he chaired Stanford's Department of Aeronautics and Astronautics, serving from 2022 to 2023 as the inaugural James and Anna Marie Spilker Chair of the department.
